### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Only include findings directly observed by the doctor or measurable data. Do not reclassify patient-reported symptoms (e.g., restlessness, worrying, irritability, headaches, muscle tension, sleep issues, overeating) as objective observations.
[P-Section]: Ensure all specific instructions or encouragements in the plan are explicitly stated by the doctor. Avoid inferring or adding specificity not present in the transcript (e.g., specific exercise types/frequencies unless explicitly mentioned).
